Move the Reducer Into Context
The solution is to lift the useReducer() call out of HomePage and into a dedicated context provider named JournalContext.jsx.
The provider holds the state and exposes both entries and dispatch() to any component that asks for them.
The reducer is pure logic, so it fits naturally at the top.
Click Run Code and you'll see that JournalContext.jsx has been created inside the context folder.
Since we haven't changed anything else yet, this file won't affect anything for now.
